notes.title: Patch Notes - Pre-Alpha v0.45
notes.notes:
Map Changes:


 Merged the inside and outside maps for seamless gameplay.


Gameplay Improvements:


 Increased stamina duration.
 Adjusted the in-game clock to start 30 minutes earlier, giving players more time to settle into the warehouse.
 Players can now use any door to enter the warehouse (subject to change).
 ESC and P keys now properly unpause the game.


Visual Updates:


 Replaced asphalt texture outside.
 Updated security camera and ventilation models.
 Made stars brighter for nighttime atmosphere.
 Revamped office window design.
 Changed clipboard paper texture and font.


System Revamps:


 Overhauled the security camera system.
 Rewrote the rules for better clarity.


Fixes:


 Resolved an issue where doors could launch players into the sky or underground.


Additions:


 Added more details to the generator room.
 Introduced new events around the map.
 Enjoy exploring the changes and let us know your feedback!Map Changes: Merged the inside and outside maps for seamless gameplay.

notes.title: Update Pre-alpha v0.44
notes.notes:
Performance Improvement: FPS inside the game increased from 25-30 to a stable 60-90 FPS.
 Loading Screen Fix: Resolved issue with flashing images during loading.
 Audio Slider: Introduced an audio slider (still work in progress). Note: It may start at 0, so adjust the volume before starting the game. This will be corrected in the next update.
 Security Camera System: Completely reworked the security room camera system.
 Lighting Update: Added more lights to improve scene illumination.


Known Issues:


 Graphics Change Crash: Changing graphics settings still causes the game to crash (will be fixed in the next update).
 Lag Spikes: Some events cause FPS drops of 30+ FPS for a second or two
 Audio loops outside noticeably
 Sprint runs out fast (Will be fixed in next update)
